integrity.limitations: Finite checks corroborate but do not prove universal claims; all critical universal steps argued symbolically.

scientific_limitations: The convergence theorem requires a complete bipartite graph, exactly two homogeneous color types, one vacancy and unilateral strictly improving jumps.
The two-vacancy example disproves the finite improvement property but does not establish nonexistence of equilibria.
The bound 2b+1 is not claimed optimal for single-peaked payoffs.
Specialized unpublished or unindexed equivalent prior results may exist.
title: One vacancy forces terminating jumps on complete bipartite networks; two vacancies can restore cycles
